annotations.title: Move or annotate a pipeline item

description: Move a pipeline item to another status (e.g. Prospect → Won) and/or add a note to its history. LACRM: EditPipelineItem.

note.description: Note to add to the item's history.

pipeline_item_id.description: The pipeline item id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

run_status_automation.description: If the status changes, run its automation. Default false.

status_id.description: The new status id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

name: lacrm_update_pipeline_item
title: Move or annotate a pipeline item
